data.gender_notes: Gerda is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Norse 'Gerðr', meaning 'spear-ruler'. In Norse mythology, Gerda is the goddess of the earth and fertility. In Christian tradition, Gerda may symbolize strength and protection. The name Gerda carries the meaning “Spear-ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gerda usually hope their child will grow to embody spear-ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Gerda belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Spear-ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gerda total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: גרדה
in_hebrew.meaning: גרדה היא שם שמקורו בגרמנית ומשמעותו שרביט או חנית
in_hebrew.long_meaning: גרדה היא שם שמקורו בגרמנית ומשמעותו שרביט או חנית. השם גרדה הוא גרסה נשית של השם גרד, שמקורו בשם הישן גרדוולד. השם גרדה אינו מופיע בתנ"ך העברי, אך הוא משמש כינוי לנשים נוצריות ברחבי העולם.

in_greek.name: Γκέρντα
in_greek.long_meaning: Γκέρντα σημαίνει ράβδος ή ακόλη. Το όνομα Γκέρντα προέρχεται από τη γερμανική γλώσσα και συγκεκριμένα από το όνομα Gerd, που σημαίνει υπερασπιστής ή προστάτης. Στην ελληνική παράδοση, το όνομα Γκέρντα δεν έχει άμεση σχέση με τη Βίβλο, αλλά χρησιμοποιείται ως σύμβολο δύναμης και προστασίας.

in_latin.name: Gerda
in_latin.long_meaning: Gerda means rod or spear. The name Gerda originates from Germanic languages, derived from the Old Norse word 'gerð', meaning enclosure or protection. In Christian tradition, Gerda is not a direct biblical reference but symbolizes strength and guardianship, reflecting virtues valued in early Christian communities.

in_english.name: Gerda
in_english.meaning: Gerda means rod or spear, symbolizing strength and protection

The name Gerda is associated with positive personality traits such as courage, leadership, and determination.
